rungs.title: Junior Data Analyst
rungs.summary: Learning the data, SQL and how to report it honestly.
rungs.knowledge: Knows the company's data, basic SQL and spreadsheets.
rungs.delivery: Builds routine reports and answers defined questions, with checks.
rungs.leadership: Asks what decision the number is for and shows their working.

rungs.title: Data Analyst
rungs.summary: Answers business questions with data and explains the result.
rungs.knowledge: Fluent in SQL, analysis, visualisation and data quality.
rungs.delivery: Takes a question to an analysis a manager can act on.
rungs.leadership: Explains findings to non-technical people and pushes back on bad questions.

rungs.title: Senior Data Analyst
rungs.summary: Owns analysis for a domain and shapes the metrics.
rungs.knowledge: Deep in statistics, experimentation, data modelling and machine learning basics.
rungs.delivery: Owns a domain's metrics and the analysis behind decisions.
rungs.leadership: Mentors and influences decisions in senior meetings.

rungs.title: Lead Data Analyst
rungs.knowledge: Designs the data model, metrics layer and standards.
rungs.delivery: Plans the analytics roadmap and owns data quality across the company.
rungs.leadership: Leads analysts and agrees priorities with every department.

rungs.title: Head of Data
rungs.knowledge: Connects data, privacy and AI to the company's strategy.
rungs.delivery: Owns data strategy, governance and the analytics budget.
rungs.leadership: Leads leaders and reports insight and risk to executives.
